the Cailleach some researchers propose instead

text: Bronach is an Irish heroine or goddess. A famous line of cliffs runs along the coast of County Clare. The highest cliff is Ceann na Cailighe, which means hag's head. It takes its name from this mythic hag. People also call her the hag of Black Head, after a nearby rocky place. Some researchers say the local Cailleach is not Bronach but Mal.

okr.objective: Describe Bronach, the hag linked to the cliffs of County Clare.
key_results: Bronach was an Irish heroine or goddess.
The cliffs of County Clare formed her setting.
The highest cliff is Ceann na Cailighe, meaning hag's head.
Some researchers name the local Cailleach as Mal instead.
